findings.title: Empty fingerprint collides all fingerprint-less findings into one closed.json slot
findings.detail: coerceFinding() falls back to fingerprint: '' when the field is missing or non-string. appendToClosedJson, appendClosedRecordUnlocked, and the batch path in markFindingsClosed all use fingerprint equality for deduplication without guarding against the empty-string sentinel. Multiple distinct findings with fingerprint '' each collide: only the first is written to closed.json, so subsequent closures of fingerprint-less findings are silently lost — regression detection based on closed.json will never see them.
findings.fix_sketch: Guard each dedup check with `record.fingerprint !== ''` (or `finding.fingerprint !== ''` / `r.fingerprint === ''`) so empty-fingerprint findings always append rather than colliding under the shared '' key.
